Container.Name: Zomboid Control Panel
Container.Overview: Web control panel for Project Zomboid. This template runs the panel beside an existing PZ container; it does not run PZ itself.
Container.Description: Runs the Zomboid Control Panel only. Use /app/data and /app/logs for panel state. /pz-server and /zomboid must point at the same host paths used by the Project Zomboid container. Do not map anything to /panel-data or /panel-logs: those paths are unused.

Config.Name: Panel data
Config.Description: Panel database, sessions, and backups. This is not PZ data.

Config.Name: Panel logs
Config.Description: Panel application logs. This is not PZ logs.

Config.Name: PZ install
Config.Description: Change to the Project Zomboid install path from your existing PZ container template.

Config.Name: PZ user data
Config.Description: Change to the Project Zomboid config, saves, logs, and PanelBridge path from your existing PZ container template.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Match the owner used by the PZ container.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Match the group used by the PZ container.

Config.Name: RCON host
Config.Description: PZ container name on a shared custom Docker network, or its fixed host/LAN address. Never use 127.0.0.1.

Config.Name: RCON port
Config.Description: Exposed RCON port from the Project Zomboid server.

Config.Name: RCON password
Config.Description: Project Zomboid RCON password. Prefer RCON_PASSWORD_FILE for a Docker secret when available.

Config.Name: CORS origins
Config.Description: Only needed if you reach the panel through a reverse proxy or public hostname instead of the LAN. Set to the exact browser origin, e.g. https://panel.example.com. Leave blank for LAN-only access.
